entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT
    p.PERSON_EMAIL,
    p.PERSON_NAME,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COUNT(d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_iap_subjects,
    MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee,
    MAX(d.FEE) AS max_fee,
    SUM(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS total_course_enrollment
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON p
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  ON p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
    p.PERSON_EMAIL,
    p.PERSON_NAME,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
    p.PERSON_NAME,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR;
